Anatomicalanat

T1w/T2w synthesis when multiple images exist:
"subject" = cross-session — one shared T1w per subject;
"session" = within-session — each session is independent;
"session_longitudinal" = same anatomical choice as "session", plus a within-subject common (base) template and base-seeded longitudinal surfaces; needs surface_reconstruction.enabled and >=2 sessions
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED: conform input to template space via FLIRT rigid registration

relabel detached label fragments smaller than this volume, in mm³, to the surrounding label; the largest piece of each label is kept; 0 = off, 2.5 is a sensible value

pre_inference_n4

second segmentation pass on an N4-corrected input, used only as network input; kept only if it agrees with the registered template at least as well as the first
"auto" = when template_prior finds more than min_missed_cm3 of brain the first pass missed (a smaller miss also counts when the first mask is under 80% of the template brain), or, with template_prior off, when the first mask is under 80% of the template brain; true = always run it. Either way the second pass is kept only if it agrees with the template at least as well as the first

Registrationregistration

anatomical to template — transform model:
translation = shift only;
rigid = shift + rotation;
affine = rigid + scaling and shearing;
syn = affine followed by nonlinear SyN
functional to anatomical — transform model:
translation = shift only;
rigid = shift + rotation;
affine = rigid + scaling and shearing;
syn = affine followed by nonlinear SyN
functional to template — transform model:
translation = shift only;
rigid = shift + rotation;
affine = rigid + scaling and shearing;
syn = affine followed by nonlinear SyN
resampling interpolation:
Linear, BSpline, Gaussian, the *WindowedSinc kernels = continuous data (images);
NearestNeighbor, GenericLabel, MultiLabel = label data, which must not be blended
attempt FireANTs for syn registration; fallback to ANTs if unavailable
preserve native functional resolution when resampling
